purpose: Verify one coherent local course release, repeated USB commissioning, Pink handoff, project identity, and two physical project runs on the attached RP2350 XRP.

repository.validationState: uncommitted correction recorded before the stage commit

releaseCoherence.failureReproduced: A dev.22 page had loaded a dev.16 commissioning manifest from an older production service worker and reinstalled dev.16 on the XRP.
correction: development removes same-origin production course workers and caches before setup begins
release and commissioning metadata use network-first retrieval with cached fallback
the page and commissioning manifest must identify the same release before USB writes
all changed commissioning assets are fetched and hash-verified before the first robot write
the development server generates and serves the current commissioning bundle instead of falling through to index.html

usbRepeatability.firstRepair: installed 8 changed files from the coherent dev.22 bundle, verified the installed release, retained Pink, and restarted the XRP
usbRepeatability.sameReleaseRepair: completed without an error, retained Pink, preserved the active Obstacle-turn project, and returned to the physical IDE

runningServiceReentry.initialFailure: one interrupt landed in an XRPLib IMU callback; the former burst-and-delay handshake then waited 20 seconds and incorrectly described the result as missing firmware
runningServiceReentry.correction: send one interrupt at a time and wait for the MicroPython friendly prompt before entering raw REPL; a failed REPL entry no longer performs a second blind command wait or claims firmware is required

projectIdentity.failureReproduced: The browser marked a just-flashed project stale because localeCompare ordered README.md differently from MicroPython's code-point ordering.
projectIdentity.correction: Use an explicit code-point comparator in the browser project revision and retain a cross-runtime regression digest.

physicalRuns.behavior: Run validated and flashed the current project, then stopped immediately because the measured forward range was about 167 mm.
Run used the retained flashed project after repeated commissioning; both wheels actuated, the encoder-derived heading changed, and final motor commands returned to zero.

remainingBoundaries: The current dev.22 correction has not yet been retested in robot-hotspot mode.
Course software is still activated one live file at a time rather than as a verified release slot.
Stable robot identity and multi-XRP shared-LAN disambiguation are not yet implemented.
Course-floor travel, moving inertial response, and changing physical ultrasound scenes remain dependent on the arena setup.
